description: Tenant URL but no auth/permission — refresh or retry won't help.

args.summary: I can’t open or access a private workspace from this browser. Please log in to your Notion account and open the “My Tenant” workspace yourself.
The Notion workspace at my-tenant.notion.site is saying "You don't have access". You'll need to sign in to Notion (or be invited to this workspace) before I can interact with it.

antiPatterns.reason: Refreshing won't produce a different result.

expected.successRubric: Report the access wall to the user, do not loop.

content: <function name="done"><param name="outcome">failed</param><param name="summary">I can’t open or access a private workspace from this browser. Please log in to your Notion account and open the “My Tenant” workspace yourself.</param></function>
